listing.releaseNotes:
Our biggest update yet.

NEW
• Proven splits come with real workouts — Push/Pull/Legs, Upper/Lower, and the new Arnold Split, ready to train.
• Lift Together: pick a friend and Splyt finds a day you can both train — invite them with the gym, time, and plan.
• Log in kilograms. Pick it once and your sets, watch, stats, and recaps follow.
• Grips and handles on rows, curls, pulldowns, and pushdowns — with "last time" weights from the same grip.
• Load the bar: tap the plates and Splyt does the math.
• Partials, on your phone and your watch.
• Heart rate by set: each set's peak, live, against last time.
• Voice logging takes your whole day at once, and shows what it heard before saving.
• Share cards on your own photo, plus a new set: scoreboard, polaroid, streak, heartbeat, PR, and more.
• A redesigned workout summary, Trends tab, friend profiles, and group pages.
• Temporary chats in Splyt AI, and all your chats in one panel.
• See what you lifted the last time you ran a workout — editing a plan fills it in.
• Forgot to stop a workout? Splyt spots when you finished and ends it there.
• Try Pro free for a week.

ON YOUR WATCH
• Switch an exercise to the one you'd actually reach for.
• Set your grip, log partials, and reorder your workout from your wrist.

IMPROVED
• Swaps suggest the obvious replacement first.
• The live heart-rate graph matches your watch and keeps going when your phone locks.
• Sleep totals match Apple Health.
• Finished splits keep their record; deleting a split never deletes finished workouts.
• Sheets drag down to close, and light mode is cleaned up across the app.

Plus dozens of fixes. Questions? Chat with the founders right in the app.
listing.description:
Staying consistent is hard when you're juggling five apps, guessing what to do next, or starting over every Monday. Splyt is one structured place for your training — with a coach that knows you, a watch that counts your reps, and friends who keep you honest.

Start with a plan that's ready to train.
Pick a proven split — Push/Pull/Legs, Upper/Lower, or the Arnold Split — and it lands on your calendar with real workouts in it. Or build your own, or have Splyt AI draft one.

Track everything that matters.
Log lifts, cardio, sleep, food, weight, and habits in seconds. Supersets, drop sets, partials, warm-up and failure sets, grips, and reps-in-reserve are all first-class, in a keyboard built for lifting — with a plate loader that does the bar math. Plans fill in what you lifted last time. Pounds or kilograms.

Just say it.
Voice logging speaks gym: "three sets of bench at 185, then superset pushdowns with dips." Log one workout or your whole day, and check what it heard before it saves.

Your AI coach, not just a chatbot.
Splyt AI remembers your goals, injuries, and routines. It draws charts from your data, drafts templates, builds week-long splits, searches the web, and can fill your live session in real time. Temporary chats stay off the record. Prefer to talk? Hands-free voice mode, from Calm to Drill Sergeant.

Your watch counts your reps.
Apple Watch counts reps on bench, shoulder press, curls, squats, triceps work, and flyes — live on your wrist. Log sets and partials by voice, set your grip, swap an exercise, or reorder your workout without touching your phone.

Heart rate, set by set.
Your real heart rate live, matching your watch, with each set's peak against last time — and every session next to your usual and your best.

Connect to the machines at your gym.
Pair Splyt to a treadmill, bike, rower, elliptical, or stair climber over Bluetooth for real speed, distance, and power. No Bluetooth? Snap the console and Splyt reads it in.

Every kind of workout — and recovery too.
Strength, outdoor runs with route maps, pool swimming, basketball, boxing, yoga, HIIT. Sauna, cold plunge, and massage count as training.

One ring for your whole day.
Your Splyt ring blends workouts, sleep, and habits into one daily target — no Apple Watch required — on your lock screen, home screen, or watch face.

Train together.
Lift Together finds a day you and a friend can both train and sends the invite. Friends see each other's workouts in a private feed — react, watch a live workout, or go head-to-head. No public posts. No fake likes.

Share it your way.
Put your session on your own photo, or pick a card: a scoreboard of every set, a polaroid, your month as a streak, a PR when you hit one.

Key Features

Workout Tracking — lifting, cardio, sports, swimming, boxing, yoga, recovery
Proven Splits — PPL, Upper/Lower, and Arnold, ready to train
Auto Rep Counting — Apple Watch counts your reps on major lifts
Voice Logging — one workout or your whole day
Heart Rate by Set — live and against your history
Splyt AI Coach (Pro) — memory, charts, voice mode, AI-built splits
Smart Gym Machines — Bluetooth treadmills, bikes, rowers, ellipticals
Lift Together, Competitions & Groups — private accountability
Share Cards — on your own photo, in dozens of styles
Progress Photos (Pro) — private, with optional AI analysis
Lifestyle Tracking — sleep, weight, habits, food
Widgets & Siri — rings and habits on your screens; start any workout by voice
Apple Health Sync — sleep stages, two-way workout sync
Import / Export — Strong, Hevy, CSV, a note, or a workout video link

Questions? The chat in the app goes straight to the founders.
